--- layout: default type_slug: sankey title: Sankey Diagram in C# — Flow Diagrams as SVG nav_title: Sankey Diagram description: Draw Sankey flow diagrams in C# with AddSankey, SankeyNode and SankeyLink — proportional ribbons between stages, as self-contained SVG. MIT licensed. permalink: /chart/types/sankey/ doc_section: Chart Reporting doc_section_url: /chart/ generated_by: scripts/split_showcase.py --- {% capture specimen %} {% endcapture %} {% capture snippet %}{% highlight csharp %}{% raw %} using TerraFluent.Chart.Reporting.Models; string svg = ChartBuilder.Create() .Title("Website Conversion Flow") .Size(760, 440) .AsAnimated() .Series(s => s .AddSankey("Flow", nodes: new[] { new SankeyNode { Name = "Visitors" }, // 0 new SankeyNode { Name = "Sign-ups" }, // 1 new SankeyNode { Name = "Trials" }, // 2 new SankeyNode { Name = "Paid" }, // 3 new SankeyNode { Name = "Churned" }, // 4 }, links: new[] { new SankeyLink { From = 0, To = 1, Value = 1000 }, new SankeyLink { From = 1, To = 2, Value = 620 }, new SankeyLink { From = 2, To = 3, Value = 240 }, new SankeyLink { From = 2, To = 4, Value = 380 }, })) .RenderToSvg(); {% endraw %}{% endhighlight %}{% endcapture %} {% include chart-type-page.html slug=page.type_slug specimen=specimen snippet=snippet %}
